run_search_augmented_factuality_eval: run the main pipeline to evaluate factuality of an LLM response against a prompt using a search-augmented rater model
classify_relevance_and_rate: classify relevance and rate all atomic facts extracted from an LLM response using a rater model
classify_relevance_and_rate_single: classify relevance and rate a single atomic fact from an LLM response sentence
count_labels: count the number of supported, irrelevant, and not supported annotations from a list of checked statements
create_checked_statement: create a CheckedStatement object to store a sentence, atomic fact, relevance data, and rating annotation
